verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents prompt-to-video generation: text prompts with control over avatar, voice and style, and a heygen-video-1 model that turns text or images into 5–30 s clips. It also documents iteration without starting over: you can review storyboards and send follow-up messages to the Video Agent before generating, then revise only the named scenes while untouched scenes keep their script and visuals. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the prompt-to-video and scene-revision workflow (all evidence is vendor docs; community items cover dubbing only).
